entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Ugh, one.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. My order number is VF8675309.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF8675309... Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It's just not what I was expecting and I'd like to return it for a refund.
I understand. Can you tell me about the condition of the VeloBand?
It's in perfect condition. I've only been wearing it for about two weeks to test it out.

Thank you for that information. Unfortunately, according to VeloFit's return policy, we can only accept returns for items that are in new and unused condition. Since the VeloBand has been worn, I am unable to process a refund for it.
What? That's completely **unacceptable**. How am I supposed to know if I like a fitness tracker without actually using it? That makes no sense.
I do understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. The policy is in place for hygiene reasons, as we cannot resell worn electronic devices.
I don't care about your reasons, I want my money back. This is ridiculous. I want to **speak to your boss** immediately. Get me a **supervisor** on the phone right now.

I am empowered to handle these situations, and a **manager** would refer to the same company policy. However, I do want to find a solution for you. Please allow me a chance to resolve this for you directly.
Fine. What can you possibly do? Because I'm not keeping this thing.

While a refund to your original payment method isn't possible, I can make a one-time exception and offer you a full store credit for the purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. You could use it towards any other VeloFit product. I can also send you a pre-paid return label right away.
So I'd get the full amount back, just as a credit to use on your site?
That is correct. You wouldn't lose any of the value. As soon as our warehouse receives the return, the credit will be applied to your VeloFit account.
Oh. Well... okay, that's actually fair. I can do that. There was a smart bike I was looking at anyway. That works for me.
Excellent! I'm so glad we could find a solution. I've just initiated that process for you, and the return label is on its way to your email. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate you working with me on this.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
